title: Create a local practice keyspace
summary: A keyspace groups Cassandra tables and defines replication.
introduction: A keyspace groups Cassandra tables and defines replication. Your task: Explain what replication_factor 1 means.
learningObjectives: Explain the example for create a local practice keyspace

blocks.text: A keyspace groups Cassandra tables and defines replication. Replication means how many copies of data are kept across nodes.
Use a local single-node Cassandra 4+ practice cluster and cqlsh. The SimpleStrategy keyspace below is only for that local lesson. These commands do not run in this site's SQLite playground.

blocks.code:
CREATE KEYSPACE IF NOT EXISTS cma_reading WITH replication = {'class':'SimpleStrategy','replication_factor':1};
USE cma_reading;
blocks.title: Create a local practice keyspace

blocks.text: Read the code step by step

items: The replication settings choose one replica for this local-only keyspace.

blocks.text: The local practice keyspace uses one replica.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: SimpleStrategy with one replica is for this local exercise, not a resilient production design. Production needs a reviewed datacenter-aware strategy.
